purpose: one-pass end-to-end integration baseline on the existing frozen eval_dataset_v1; not an independent generalization benchmark

execution.structured_input_binding: frozen structured-evidence operation name and non-answer parameters only; expected values and literature Gold are never passed to graph components

recovery_success_definition: Among recovery-triggered cases with Initial CompleteEvidence@10=false, Final CompleteEvidence@10=true.
unsafe_answer_definition: answer_ready while Final CompleteEvidence@10=false for a literature-bearing case, or answer_ready for a Gold-unanswerable case.
unnecessary_abstention_definition: abstain_ready for a Gold-answerable case when applicable final required literature evidence is complete, the required Tool set is exact, and all required Tool executions succeeded.
